the screen: x 45, y 107, 103 × 129 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.4464 (spec 0.45), screen at the exact 128:160 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://i.blogs.es/6043eb/07-sony-ericsson-t280/2560_3000.webp (press render of the T280a, Xataka Movil gallery)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://i.blogs.es/6043eb/07-sony-ericsson-t280/2560_3000.webp); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/t280i/).
